```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!-- parameter entity comment -->">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity">
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Leading top-level comment -->
  <?target-pi inner="true"?>
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block containing <tags> & &ent; references ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; &base; &base;">
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd-ext">
  %ext;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment in catalog -->
  <?catalog-pi action="init"?>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some complex CDATA with embedded entities like &complex;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&complex;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Second">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY ent3 'Parameter Entity Text'>">
  %pEnt;
  <?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="urn:archive:ns" xmlns:meta="urn:archive:meta">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <?meta:process mode="strict"?>
  <record meta:id="r1">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive CDATA section <record>with markers</record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&ent2; and &ent3;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY node-ref "Default Node Value">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % internal-macro "<!ENTITY macro-text 'Expanded Macro'>">
  %internal-macro;
  <?debug-mode status="active"?>
]>
<system xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/system" xmlns:cfg="http://schemas.example.com/config">
  <!-- System configuration comment block -->
  <?cfg:load profile="default"?>
  <node cfg:active="true">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing &node-ref; and &macro-text;
    ]]>
  </node>
  <node>&macro-text;</node>
</system>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY data "Safe Data">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-snippet "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %dtd-snippet;
  <?xml-stylesheet href="default.css"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:custom="http://example.com/custom">
  <!-- Document level comment covering header details -->
  <?custom:processor type="fast" verbose="yes"?>
  <section custom:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Special CDATA section with unparsed entities &data; and markup <test/>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&data;</section>
</document>
```
